title: Analytic Bridge Diffusions for Controlled Path Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.02961v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Most modern bridge-diffusion methods achieve finite-time transport by specifying an interpolation, Schrodinger-bridge, or stochastic-control objective and then learning the associated score or drift field with a neural network. In contrast, we identify a restricted but sufficiently broad analytically solvable class in which, for a deterministic source and a Gaussian-mixture target, the score and all intermediate marginals are explicit and protocol objectives of the type used in this paper can be differentiated without inner stochastic simulation loops. We recast the classical linear--quadratic--Gaussian stochastic-control structure as a transport problem of the Path Integral Diffusion type. Linear dynamics, Gaussian noise, and quadratic running costs reduce the bridge calculation to a matrix Riccati cascade, while the terminal state cost is replaced by a prescribed Gaussian-Mixture terminal probability density. translated_title: 用于受控路径生成的解析桥扩散方法
translated_abstract: 大多数现代桥扩散方法通过指定插值、薛定谔桥或随机控制目标，并利用神经网络学习相应的得分或漂移场，来实现有限时间传输。相比之下，我们识别出一个受限但足够广泛的解析可解类，其中对于确定性源和高斯混合目标，得分和所有中间边际分布都是显式的，并且本文使用的协议目标可以在无需内部随机模拟循环的情况下进行微分。我们将经典的线性-二次-高斯随机控制结构重新表述为路径积分扩散类型的传输问题。线性动力学、高斯噪声和二次运行成本将桥计算简化为矩阵Riccati级联，而终端状态成本则被替换为指定的高斯混合终端概率密度。
tldr: 本文提出了一类解析可解的桥扩散方法，通过线性-二次-高斯控制结构实现确定性源到高斯混合目标的显式传输，无需神经网络训练或内部模拟。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an analytically solvable class of bridge diffusions that achieves explicit transport from deterministic sources to Gaussian-mixture targets via linear-quadratic-Gaussian control, eliminating the need for neural network training or inner simulations.
